title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon S: Jougai Rantou!? Shuyaku Soudatsusen - Hikawa Shrine (Front)
description:
The front layer of the Hikawa Shrine stage in Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon S (...) for the Super Famicom.

While it's supposed to be "foreground", you can have this as a background and complement it with some invisible cement block/ledges (and maybe Layer 3) to make a nice effect, but also keep in mind that looping this background would be weird. Setting vertical scrolling to None is needed too, since the graphics lacks part of the ceiling.
